method.abstention: Per-click-count 95th percentile of correctly classified leave-one-out nearest-family MSE distances.
method.comparison: MSE against family mean, restricted to equal click count.
method.measured_rhythm_calibration: Duration, ICI-CV, and absolute normalized-slope quantiles, grouped only by equal click count in EC1.
method.percentile: Percent of same-family reference distances greater than or equal to the query distance.
method.population: EC1 rows only; all *-NOISE labels excluded
method.rhythm_normalization: Each ICI divided by total coda duration (sum of ICIs).
